build_dataset_download_and_prepare: build a python module to download and prepare a dataset using DatasetBuilder with arrow format
create_builder_config: create a BuilderConfig subclass with custom name, version, and data_dir properties for a dataset
generate_dataset_split: generate dataset splits by implementing _split_generators to return SplitGenerator objects with gen_kwargs
load_dataset_as_arrow: load a prepared dataset as an Arrow Dataset using as_dataset with a specific split name
stream_iterable_dataset: create a streaming IterableDataset using as_streaming_dataset to process data without downloading
